messages:
Will Harper: Quick plan: run a combined deliverable — 1 short tutorial (vector+stream), 1 tiny refapp repo, and a 30-min webinar where we live-run a compact benchmark. Goal = dev signups + repo forks + demo PRs.
Nina Flores: Love it. What's the launch week?
Will Harper: Target June 8. Publish tutorial June 1, open repo June 4, webinar June 8. Promo starts May 25.
Samir Gupta: For the benchmark narrative: keep it simple. Compare community-base vs quantized on Redwood Dedicated. Show p50/p95, tokens/sec, and estimated $/1k tokens. One slide + live run.
Lola Chen: I can draft the tutorial — 6 steps, code snippets, and a short bench section. Aim for <900 words.
Will Harper: CTA = webinar RSVP (capture email, role, company_size). Post-event CTA = repo + hosted trial coupon. Hidden fields: signup_reason (eval/pilot/POC) and model_interest (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).
Samir Gupta: I'll prepare a lightweight bench script snippet for the tutorial:
```
# bench 30 requests
python bench.py --model community-base --quantize int8 --seq 512 --requests 30 --warmup 5 --out summary.json
cat summary.json | jq '.summary | {p50,p95,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k}'
```
Use warmup=5 for stable numbers.
Nina Flores: Lead routing: form -> #marketing-leads + HubSpot. Map company_size, role, utm_campaign. Add `priority` tag from signup_reason. Ops confirm webhook?
OpsBot: webhook test to /integrations/hubspot/mini-launch -> success.
Lola Chen: Design assets needed: hero image, 8s GIF of demo streaming, and one slide with benchmark numbers. Can design deliver by May 30?
Will Harper: Yes, we need assets by May 30 to lock landing. Promo cadence: announce May 25, tutorial June 1, repo open June 4, webinar invite push June 2, reminders 48h + 2h before.
Samir Gupta: For reliability: pre-record the benchmark run and have a fallback model `community-base-quant` in case Dedicated slot noisy. Ops: reserve small Dedicated capacity for the demo window.
OpsBot: Dedicated slot reserved: June 8 15:00-16:00 UTC -> confirmed.
Nina Flores: GDPR check: add explicit consent checkbox and privacy link. Also capture region (NA/EU/APAC) to route leads.
Lola Chen: I'll draft 3 headline variants for A/B: 1) "Mini-lab: Repro Bench & Refapp" 2) "See latency & cost live" 3) "Build vector+stream in 10 minutes".
Will Harper: Keep messaging pragmatic: numbers-first, example snippet: "p50 90ms | cost 0.7¢/k token (quant)" in social copy.
Samir Gupta: I'll seed repo `community-mini-lab` with bench.ipynb + demo server. We'll keep private until publish.
Nina Flores: Routing: Dev leads go to #marketing-leads and HubSpot; sales gets notified for `priority=pilot` > immediate.
Lola Chen: Review windows: tutorial draft May 27, bench script May 28, landing copy May 29. Who can review?
Will Harper: I'll do copy review May 29. Samir will do tech review May 28. Nina will confirm routing May 29.
OpsBot: Dry-run scheduled: June 6 16:00 UTC -> invites sent.
Will Harper: Action items assigned on marketing board under "mini-lab: replayable benchmark & refapp". Quick thumbs if you're aligned. :thumbsup:
Nina Flores: :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: :thumbsup:
Lola Chen: :thumbsup:
OpsBot: thread archived for tracking.
